title: AC-20 parity: author manual scenario now or wire an automated runner
context: CI-12 states ChatGPT/Codex parity runs are MANUAL and recorded unless S0 finds a scriptable Codex runner; an automated cross-host runner is S3 scope. S2 can author tests/evals/scenarios/s2.yml as a recorded manual parity scenario, or attempt to wire an automated runner now.

options.label: Author s2.yml manual parity scenario only; defer runner to S3 (recommended)
Attempt to wire an automated ChatGPT/Codex runner now

rationale: Owner chose to wire an automated cross-host parity runner now rather than defer to S3
